definitions.explanation: A prefecture on the Kii Peninsula in the Kansai region, facing the Pacific Ocean. Known for mikan oranges, umeboshi plums, and the sacred Kumano Kodō pilgrimage routes.

examples.japanese: {和歌山県|わかやまけん}は{梅|うめ}の{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Wakayama Prefecture is famous as a producer of plums.

examples.japanese: {和歌山県|わかやまけん}には{世界遺産|せかいいさん}の{熊野古道|くまのこどう}がある。
examples.english: Wakayama Prefecture has the World Heritage Kumano Kodō pilgrimage routes.

examples.japanese: {和歌山県|わかやまけん}の{南部|なんぶ}は{年間|ねんかん}を{通|とお}して{温暖|おんだん}な{気候|きこう}だ。
examples.english: The southern part of Wakayama Prefecture has a mild climate year-round.

notes:
A prefecture in the {関西|かんさい} region. The capital is {和歌山市|わかやまし}.

FAMOUS FOR:
- {梅干|うめぼ}し: pickled plums, especially Nanko-ume variety
- みかん: mandarin oranges (top producer alongside Ehime)
- {熊野古道|くまのこどう}: ancient pilgrimage routes (UNESCO World Heritage)
- {高野山|こうやさん}: Mt. Kōya, headquarters of Shingon Buddhism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {奈良県|ならけん}: Nara Prefecture — neighbor to the north
- {三重県|みえけん}: Mie Prefecture — neighbor to the east, also on the Kii Peninsula
